signature.name: VTask.ofLinearMap
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {A : Type v} -> {B : Type w} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Algebra R B] -> (f : A →ₗ[R] B) -> (map_one : f 1 = 1) -> (map_mul : ∀ (x y : A), f (x * y) = f x * f y) -> A →ₐ[R] B

conventions.statement: The `commutes` field of the resulting `AlgHom` (compatibility with `algebraMap`) is derived automatically from `R`-linearity of `f` and the hypothesis `map_one`; the caller does not need to supply it.
conventions.note: This is an implicit convention of the constructor: fewer axioms are required as inputs than the full `AlgHom` structure contains.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {A : Type*} {B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (h1 : f 1 = 1) (hmul : ∀ x y : A, f (x * y) = f x * f y), (VTask.ofLinearMap f h1 hmul) 1 = 1
